description: Grupo de la secundaria de formación profesional en automatización de santa rosa de calamuchita 1 año A
summary: It is a Martian space life simulator that is still in the beta phase. It's about living on a hostile planet with the available resources. Our proposal is an immersive game to think about how humans could live on Mars with water, oxygen, food, and energy, though later on, players will be able to fly rockets to other planets, harvest, drive, and play in co-op mode.
details:
• 1 Enables human life on Mars (o "Allows for human life on Mars")
  • 2 Food, oxygen, water, and energy
  • 3 An immersive game
  • 4 Built with AI like Codex, using Roblox Studio as the main software (literalmente: "With AI like Codex, and Roblox Studio as the software")
  • 5 It is creative because we simulate life on Mars through Roblox Studio
  • 6 Work organization and schedules (o "Task organization and scheduling")
